core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jabeer is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Companion, Partner”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jabeer corresponds to the Arabic form جبير (Arabic جُبَيْر (Jubayr)). Its core sense is jubayr; diminutive of jabir. Jabeer is Arabic جُبَيْر (Jubayr), the diminutive of جَابِر (Jābir).
